messages:
sam: running the docker-compose onboarding stack and noticed oddness: access logs show one request_id but our SDK logs show another for the same request. feels like two different request ids are being stitched. anyone seen this with fluentd sidecar?

irene: hmm can you paste the two lines?

sam: sure:```[2025-03-14T09:12:01.200Z] access: request_id=rid-42 method=POST path=/signup user=seed_user
[2025-03-14T09:12:01.203Z] sdk: level=debug request_id=req-abc123 trace.id=1a2b3c message=created user.email=sam@local.test```

ben: that looks like the access proxy (nginx) sets `request_id` header, and the SDK autoinit creates its own `request_id` field from trace context. Fluentd/sidecar then normalizes fields and ends up with two different values. ordering of log enrichment matters.

irene: root cause is twofold: 1) autoinit runs early and binds trace->request mapping, 2) compose uses `fluentd` driver with a filter that renames fields into `request_id` after logs are emitted. so the SDK's structured attr `request_id` can be overwritten or duplicated.

sam: repro steps I used: `git clone && docker-compose -f docker/local-compose.yaml up --build`, hit `/signup` with seed payload, then `docker-compose logs proxy | grep request_id` and `docker-compose logs app | grep request_id`.

infra-bot: for local repro you can also run:```LOG_LEVEL=debug docker-compose -f docker/local-compose.yaml up --build --abort-on-container-exit``` and inspect `docker/local-compose.yaml` to swap `logging.driver: "json-file"` to avoid fluentd transformations.

ben: quick mitigations: - set LOG_LEVEL=info in onboarding compose (reduces debug leakage) - change seed emails to `user+<n>@example.invalid` (non-deliverable domain) - register a small OTEL log processor in sampleapp that normalizes/filters before export.

irene: other option: have SDK autoinit accept `REDACT_ON_INIT=true` so it registers a redaction/log-processor early, or expose `AUTOINIT_DELAY` env var that delays instrumentation until express middlewares mount. both are doable.

sam: I'm going to open a tiny PR that: 1) sets onboarding compose default LOG_LEVEL=info 2) updates seeds to `example.invalid` emails 3) adds a README note about `logging.driver` and `fluentd` caveats.

telemetry-bot: Created ticket INF-789: "onboarding compose: mismatched request_id and potential PII exposure when using fluentd sidecar" — https://tracker.internal/INF-789 :bug:

ben: long term we should standardize on a single canonical request id key (e.g., `x-rd-request-id` header -> `rd.request_id` attribute) and document middleware ordering. also add a test that fails if `logs/*.log` contain `@` domains during CI smoke for onboarding.

sam: assigning myself for the small PR and adding a checklist in docs/onboarding-telemetry.md. will ping when ready. :raised_hands:
